# Semlink 2.4.2

Second CSS lint compliance patch, again with no intended behavior changes: eliminates every remaining warning from the community plugin review's stylesheet analysis except two deliberate scrollbar resets.

## 🧹 Styles cleanup

- Removed all `text-indent` hanging indents (4 sites): the first-line icon pull now uses a negative margin on the icon itself — pixel-identical rows, no first-line indent property
- Removed the transparent-underline hover pattern on the onboarding "reconfigure" link: plain `none → underline` on hover (underline spacing is identical; the subtle color fade is dropped)
- Removed all `display: contents` uses (3 sites):
  - The home screen grid moved down into the welcome container itself, and the input card temporarily joins it there on the home screen (the grid rows and gaps are unchanged); leaving home restores the card to its normal slot
  - The settings slider rows place the control directly as the second grid row; a dead `.slider-value` rule with no renderer was dropped along with it
- Removed all `!important` declarations (8 sites): the global hide utility is now a doubled class at the end of the stylesheet (specificity + file order instead of force), the scroll-to-bottom button no longer carries the hide class at all, and the editor focus-ring suppression wins on specificity
- Removed a redundant `scrollbar-width: none` (the `::-webkit-scrollbar` rule already covers it)

## 📝 Known remaining warnings

- Two `scrollbar-color/width: auto` reset declarations remain intentionally: they neutralize the host app's inherited scrollbar properties so the custom thin scrollbars keep working (removing them regressed scrollbar styling before)

**Download**: main.js, manifest.json and styles.css are attached to this release. Updating from inside Obsidian picks up all three automatically.
